newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks drop by lunch, foreign buying slows.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks drop by lunch, foreign buying slows.

text.p: Thai stocks were lower by the lunchbreak on Friday as technical buying by overseas funds slowed and fundamental concerns and finance sector turmoil combined to push the market lower, traders said.
The SET Index was 0.52 points or 0.10 percent lower to 519.50 by the recess. The SET 50 added 0.05 points or 0.05 percent to 37.65. Turnover was 3.28 billion baht.
"The only reason the market was going up was overseas buying which I think was purely technical ... those funds may now have done their spending," said a trader at National Finance and Securities.
